notes.title: Visual Novel Mode Update & flash sale!
notes.notes:
Being a detective is hard work. You can't just spend all day at your computer. So we are bringing Interrogation to mobile! Grab it now on [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/interrogation-deceived/id1495159910]iOS[/url] and [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mixtvision.interrogation]Android[/url].
We are also introducing the [i]all new Visual Novel Mode[/i] on all platforms!

This new mode is a more relaxed way to experience the story of Interrogation. It lets you follow the thrilling plot by guiding you through the dialogue for the most part. You still get to make moral decisions, but there is no game over. The best of both worlds!

Last but not least we have a little something special: 
We know that a lot of us are spending more time at home these days, so we partnered with our friends at FAR: Lone Sails for a flash sale starting 10am PST to help pass the time. We just came out with our brand new Visual Novel mode & FAR dropped its price lower than ever before - stay safe and we hope you enjoy the games!

You can get FAR here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/609320/FAR_Lone_Sails/

Be safe out there, detective!
[i]- Team Interrogation[/i]

notes.title: Game patch: Achievements available now!
notes.notes:
